section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a study (referred to as Study X) that investigated the associations between body image and happiness in 9,667 Western women. Participants completed an online survey providing demographic data, measures of body dissatisfaction, body appreciation, and subjective happiness. The study found that body appreciation positively predicted subjective happiness, and BMI was negatively associated with body appreciation.
